kind: read-only next-slice production integration plan; no implementation

decision.firstTarget: Opt-in main text surface only, inside the existing native composer card. No permanent WK, new connection, new ledger, or backend change.
decision.supersedes: qa/native-editor-production-contract.json has historical unresolved fields that semantic f8 and actual Proof3 have since closed; preserve that report as history.

evidence.componentSemantic: qa/native-semantic-cross-final-review.json; fixed f8e450e8fb1e1e70aa6156321572d1d06b4d0f096df7324fccda3599539b5192, independent4Go+5AppKit checks, author48AppKit; object-only/programmatic scope.

proof3.passed: Root actual single-click coherent Go/native/chrome themes, chip retained, candidate physical click, native popup focus preservation.
proof3.limits: Local fixture on M4/macOS27.2.1; not production adapter, actual Host submission, physical IME, PNG/drop, dynamic height, two-window lifecycle or M1/macOS15.8 device acceptance.

architecture.lifetime: One Editor/NSScrollView/NSTextView per window, created outside view(c). A window-owned semantic adapter+DocumentStore survives composerState reloads. Existing composerState is still session/account/Host-generation scoped and may be replaced by navigation; same-scope reloadComposer currently reuses it.
architecture.documentID: composer_native.DocumentID{AccountScope,HostID,SessionID,Slot:"main"}; stable across transport reconnect. Separate callback epoch captures window ID, Editor.ID, active DocumentID, navigation generation and transport generation.
architecture.editingAuthority: Native semantic document/undo is active edit authority; Store is the validated semantic mirror and receipt target. a.draft/a.drafts remain compatibility canonical mirrors, never independent mutation authorities or send eligibility.
architecture.surface: Only replace TextAreaBase. Retain image rail/preview/intake, model and permission labels, toolbar/plan, queue dock and queue MyGo editor, approval/question views, WK ownership and Remote operations.
architecture.queueScope: First cut keeps queue editing in its existing MyGo TextArea. Do not reattach the single main native surface to a simultaneously visible queue editor. A later rich queue surface requires an explicit per-slot owner, not reuse behind the main input.

minimalSeams.responsibility: Window-owned adapter: BindDocument, SyncSnapshotAndCapture, AcceptNativeEvent, ReplaceSpanCAS, Focus, SetStyle, SetPresentationOcclusion, SettleAccepted, RetireAccount/Window. Feature flag defaults false. No transport method.

minimalSeams.changes: Own adapter/store and one Editor per window; initialize absolute bundled dylib path, callback epoch and public Theme.OnUpdated→Window.Update; close exactly once after exporting semantics and retiring window owners. No native creation inside composerView.

A surface-neutral input action seam replaces direct ui.Element TextSelection/ReplaceText/OnTextKey assumptions. Completion discovery/catalogs/capabilities stay existing. Native branch uses detect-text UTF16/plain runs; old branch keeps current rune APIs. Toolbar buttons and keyboard enter the same composerSubmit mode policy.

Attach optional immutable semantic SubmissionCapture to the existing sendIntent before request dispatch; keep existing stable wire-payload unknown ledger. Accepted semantic settlement branch replaces only legacy string-clear logic for native intents. Old widget path unchanged.

Expose existing accepted command request ID to the semantic completion callback; typed slash/permission can consume captured semantic prefix/span, while toolbar permission never consumes draft. Preserve dangerous-mode confirmation and client-effect boundary checks.

minimalSeams.existing: navigation/restore: connection.go connect/chooseSession, session_actions.go clearMain, restoration.go adoptAccountScope
minimalSeams.changes: Synchronize/export old semantic document before changing target; retain its ordinary navigation undo; bind new stable doc with fresh callback epoch. Keep existing image and list-scroll scope behavior.
Route this currently direct a.draft write through explicit semantic insertion/initialization CAS. CallerPage/owner/scope guards remain. No stale string mirror assignment into a live native doc.

Only after separate source approval: add missing bounded bind/hot-restore, paste/drop handoff, height and focus commands/events; build/sign/package dylib. Current f8/Proof3 component and GUI11 artifacts stay frozen during this plan.

admission.event: Immediate FFI event is only a candidate. Before UI mutation match Editor ID, window liveness, active document/account/Host, callback epoch, navigation/generation; Store.Accept each valid returned snapshot. On error call Store.Fence with monotonic maximum revision; do not swallow it or keep sending old canonical mirror.
admission.send: On Go UI thread, synchronously Editor.Apply(snapshot) -> validate current owner/epoch, DecodeSnapshot/Store.Accept -> Store.Capture with exact captured image IDs; also require Editor.Valid and !Marked/Invalid. Only then construct existing send intent/payload. This closes the valid-Store/queued-native-invalid race; Editor.Valid alone and Store.Capture alone are each insufficient.
admission.recovery: Only a newer current-scope valid frame may release invalid fence. Old valid or identifiable old-scope malformed events are inert. Headerless malformed may conservatively fence current carrier but never lower a barrier.
admission.coordinates: NSTextView detect selection/spans are UTF16; a reference is1 U+FFFC. Existing Go TextArea uses rune indices, and Snapshot.NativeToCanonical returns canonical runes, not canonical UTF16. Use tagged ranges and explicit conversion; never inspect @ text expanded inside a chip as editable token.
admission.reference: Only Kind=reference + Source=reference, exact Ref==ClipboardText, unique occurrence IDs and actual Host canonical mention. Unknown source/plugin codec, malformed refs and literal structural U+FFFC reject without mutating the document. ReplaceSpan CAS uses content semantic revision+digest plus captured token span; style/selection changes do not change content revision.

receiptTransaction.identity: Capture DocumentID/account/Host/session/StoreKey/epoch, semantic runs/revision/digest and AttachmentIDs at send-intent creation, before any request can complete. Never calculate old target from current UI on callback.
receiptTransaction.dedup: Preserve existing wire payload text/content-hash unknown ledger. Do not use a new chip occurrence/digest to bypass an unknown identical wire payload. Semantic digest is additionally for exact local prefix/occurrence settlement, not a replacement remote idempotency key.
activeAccepted: Require existing accepted receipt + exact original request ID; do not import Proof3 fixture submit/unknown maps.

On main thread take a fresh validated native snapshot and preflight captured runs/digest/identity. If invalid/marked, defer settlement under existing accepted intent; no settled marker until application succeeds.

Before any native mutation check AlreadySettled/conflict using a proposed read-only Store.PrepareAccepted ticket over its EXISTING settled map. A cold-accepted request replayed after rebind/retyping must be inert even if native appliedCommits reset. Do not create a second request ledger.

If the ticket is actionable, apply native commitAccepted using current semantic CAS and original captured runs/digest/request ID first; an Apply failure must not advance Store to a different document.

After native success, run Store.CommitAccepted on the same captured doc/request then reconcile returned native snapshot through Store.Accept; compare expected remaining digest. Treat any disagreement as fenced synchronization error, never clear native text by assigning a.draft.
Mirror resulting canonical text only to the still-current binding; release only original accepted AttachmentIDs through existing acceptComposerAttachments. New suffix/refs/images remain.
receiptTransaction.coldAccepted: For an inactive captured DocumentID settle only its Store entry; never switch/focus the live native view. On returning, seed the cold updated semantics and cut committed undo. Store settled-request marker makes duplicate receipts inert even after user retypes identical canonical text. If cold entry is fenced/marked, queue deferred settlement until a fresh valid bind; do not clear it blindly.
receiptTransaction.commandAccepted: Typed slash and permission token need their existing mutation request ID and captured semantic prefix/span. Toolbar permission has no draft settlement. Keep matched/client-effect checks and confirmation. Command+image remains unsupported and retained.
receiptTransaction.imageOnly: Empty captured runs cannot clear newly typed text; accepted original image IDs can retire independently of new IDs. Mixed text+image uses only existing content carrier, never simultaneous text+content.

retention.ordinaryNavigation: Swift scope already saves NSAttributedString+selection+UndoManager per doc; it restores only if full semantic digest matches. Keep this for A→B→A. Do not call native retireDocument on every session switch, nor use transport generation as document identity. Store entry may become cold while native undo remains resident.
retention.originalBoundary: Pinned input/hub.ts ties shells to retained Session bindings and disposes all listeners/document attachments when that binding scope releases; runtime.ts cuts undo on committed clear/restoration. Match a real app-owned logical scope release, not a guessed LRU based on visited-row count.
retention.twoTiers: Go Store retains unsent semantic runs/selection, separately from Swift hot attributed/undo objects. Explicit retireDocument/retireAccount requires successful semantic export/digest proof; it clears native undo/docs only, not unsent semantic drafts. Account change retires old native hot state and focus; delayed receipts still target captured old Store ID.
retention.window: Close clears every current/saved native UndoManager/document and callback registry; stable outer foreign NSView may intentionally remain host-retained until window teardown. Dylib API is process-cached rather than dlclosed under live custom Objective-C objects. Test multiwindow/early close after public host teardown.
retention.memoryGate: Saved native undo/documents have no automatic budget yet;1 surface/window is not a memory bound. No LRU may discard an unsent draft. Before default replacement define retained-session disposal or export/cold-history strategy; measure object counts, native peak/RSS and image textures separately.

capabilityGaps.source: Current Store.CommitAccepted checks its private settled map and mutates semantic runs in the same call. Native commitAccepted is a separate CAS command; production has no proven two-model transaction yet.
capabilityGaps.minimal: Add read-only PrepareAccepted over the existing settled map (AlreadySettled/conflict/deferred, expected current digest/revision and projected prefix decision). On one UI transaction, prepare -> native CAS -> existing Store.CommitAccepted -> validate returned snapshot. No new transport ledger. Cold settlement uses Store alone; replay after cold restore must skip native before it can delete retyped text.
capabilityGaps.gate: Cold accepted -> rebind -> retype identical prefix/new occurrence -> duplicate accepted is inert; active marked/invalid defers; native CAS rejection leaves Store unadvanced; unexpected post-native mismatch fences rather than reseeds.

capabilityGaps.status: required protocol design before lossless production
capabilityGaps.source: Swift scope compares seededDigest with saved.semanticDigest and overwrites saved content/undo on mismatch; Go only retains last validated semantic snapshot when native frame exceeds1MiB or is malformed.
capabilityGaps.risk: A→B→A using stale Go seed could replace the newer invalid/oversize native A draft. Current scope response also cannot bind an oversized snapshot through the1MiB decoder.
capabilityGaps.minimal: Add explicit non-destructive activation of an existing hot document, with bounded owner/doc/account/epoch/revision/digest acknowledgement even while body is invalid/tooLarge; Editor may update the binding from that typed ack while Store remains fenced. No seed overwrite. Alternatively fully export exact native semantics through a bounded channel before any retire. Do not trap navigation or silently use the old mirror.
capabilityGaps.gate: Oversize/malformed current document→switchB→returnA keeps exact native contents and remains send-disabled until edited back to a fresh valid state; old callbacks/receipts cannot clear it.

capabilityGaps.source: Swift paste emits pasteAttachments with text only, while normal TextArea synchronously reads transfer.PNG/FileList. Current Swift eager pb.data(forType:.png) checks/copies then discards it.
capabilityGaps.minimal: Use offered-type negotiation and immediate callback-time public mygo.Clipboard.Read(transfer.PNG or FileList), which copies representations and rejects clipboard-owner changes. Capture compressed Data, full document scope and UTF16 replacement CAS before Window.Update/worker; no PNG base64 in snapshot JSON. If rejected, show explicit retained-draft error. Reuse composerPasteImages/intake/ImageIO and all6 Host limits +1MiB stdio budget.
capabilityGaps.gate: Clipboard changes before queued UI work cannot import different bytes; mixed text+PNG insertion, undo boundary, offline/missinglimit, image-only/combined carrier, unknown receipt, new-image preservation.

capabilityGaps.source: External NSTextView receives drops directly; existing card.DroppedFiles cannot be assumed to receive an event owned by that NSView.
capabilityGaps.minimal: Explicit app-owned drag destination hands supported file URLs and scoped replacement location to Go composerAddImageFiles; system plain-path/file/image insertion is not an implicit fallback. Generic staged file receipt still unavailable.
capabilityGaps.gate: Actual drop onto text area and outer card; multiple images/invalid file/late navigation; no raw bitmap or invalid path text inserted.

capabilityGaps.source: Component scroll/text starts fixed600x96 and has no content-height event; normal TextArea uses Lines(1,14), FontSize+10 and responsive card.
capabilityGaps.minimal: Expose bounded width-dependent measured line height from AppKit layout after content/selection/width/font changes; UI uses finite1..14line clamp, preserves internal scroll/caret, event-driven invalidation with geometry signature. No polling/layout-feedback loop.
capabilityGaps.gate: Narrow420/wide layouts, font10/14/22, multiline paste/chips/emoji/IME, height caps and scroll; all bounds finite.

capabilityGaps.source: Public NativeView supplies clipped hole/covers and hide-when-unbuilt. Proof3 generic popup is not the actual model WK overlapping the composer or permission/settings modal.
capabilityGaps.minimal: Preserve native selection independently of focus. Explicit blur/restore-intent commands when opening model WK/permissions/settings/image lightbox/queue editor; do not continually focus on rerender. Restore only after overlay owner closes and only if same document and user has not focused another control. Keep existing WK owner/CallerPage/generation lifetime.
capabilityGaps.gate: Actual model WK anchor overlaps native text without pointer theft/paint bleed; type/filter/Escape restores expected responder; approval/modals/queue/sidebar focus and blur preserve chips/undo; late owner close does not focus another session.

capabilityGaps.minimal: First cut only display/edit/copy built-in file/session refs. No activateReference event exists; original click-to-open file and arbitrary plugin/quote serialization need separate owner/codec wiring. Keep these explicitly partial, never route an unknown chip to CanonicalText send.

capabilityGaps.status: source/programmatic gate exists; actual system IME pending
capabilityGaps.minimal: hasMarkedText keys continue through AppKit super interpretation; never submit from composition commit. Strict plain/Cmd/Ctrl/Shift rules and repeat/shortcut consumption reuse normal Go policy.
capabilityGaps.gate: Actual system Pinyin Return confirms candidate and CmdEnter while marked never sends/steers/cancels. Run only injected local transport, not live Host.

capabilityGaps.status: normal packager does not build/copy component
capabilityGaps.minimal: Build composer_native/*.swift only with target arm64-apple-macos15.8 into a fresh candidate Contents/Frameworks/libNativeComposer.dylib. Do not include QA Probe.swift. CGO_ENABLED=0 Go loads absolute executable-relative Frameworks path; missing/failing dylib uses old widget and retains Store. Sign nested dylib/runtime before outer app; manifest all dylib/source/Swift/toolchain/runtime inputs.
capabilityGaps.gate: Inspect vtool/otool architecture/minOS/dependencies/install-name, no developer absolute paths, strict nested codesign, launch outside repo, one/two window teardown, missing dylib fallback. Local ad-hoc is enough for development; do not require notarization to keep this local slice moving. Actual15.8+M1 runtime remains separate.

deliveryOrder.deliverable: Keep GUI11 and all proofs immutable; new source opt-in flag off, pure-Go document adapter interface and local fixture harness, complete binding/invalid-hot-restore plan.

Existing card/rail/toolbars remain. Bind actual main native editor with semantic/range/candidate adapter, per-session undo, coherent theme, plain input/ref chips; all nonimage editing and focus fixture gates. No default switch.

Actual normal Go composerSubmit/sendPayload/command machinery with injected real RemoteAdapter fixture, immutable semantic intent captured before dispatch; active/cold/deferred/duplicate/unknown/rejected receipt matrix, queue modes and permission confirmation preserved. No fixture Submit copy and no live prompt.
PNG capture, native drop, dynamic height, actual overlapping WK/modal focus, invalid/oversize navigation recovery and hot-object retention; preserve existing images/rail/suffix in all branches.

Root CUA on a distinct normal-composer local-fixture candidate, actual Pinyin/paste/drop/pointer/height/dark-light and multiwindow gates; source/bundle/floor/sign hashes; then user M1Air end-to-end performance comparison. Only later explicitly reviewed default promotion.

mandatoryFixtures: Current Editor invalid12 queued ahead of prior valid11 must fence Store; synchronous toolbar send cannot capture an older valid mirror; fresh current13 can recover.
Same canonical text but new occurrence/ref ID does not let old accepted receipt erase new draft; same wire payload unknown cannot obtain a new request ID.
CJK+emoji before chip / middle replacement / two-end selection / trailing space / undo-redo / copy canonical exact bytes.
A/B fast crossworkspace, same session ID across Host/account, account logout/return, queued prior epoch; all affect only captured semantic ID and image StoreKey.
Accepted prefix plus newly typed suffix/new images; image-only accepted while text typed; rejected/unknown preserve document/attachments and stable intent.
Permission toolbar consumes nothing; typed slash consumes captured token only; confirm cancel preserves draft; unavailable browser effects remain blocked.
Queue-mode Enter/CmdEnter/ShiftEnter and empty accelerated steer use existing logic; Swift never sends directly.

50scope reuse plus50window create/close with public runloop drain distinguish fixed platform retention from growth; semantic drafts retained and native undo/docs released only at documented boundaries.
actualGuiBeforeDefault: Use same production composer + local injected transport; every write gate is fixture-only. Do not send a prompt to the connected MacMini to test editing.
Physical Pinyin candidate Enter/CmdEnter; native filter @ and real coordinate pointer selection; copy/cut/delete/undo across chip/command edges.
Image picker/rail/preview/remove plus actual PNG paste and actual file drop onto NativeView, mixed text and images, out-of-order receipt after navigation.
Model WK anchored popover and permission/settings/approval/image modals overlapping text, Escape and focus restoration without ghost input.
1..14line responsive height, scroll caret, font10/14/22, forced light/dark on opposite host appearance with single click.
Two windows, early close, session/Host/account switching, invalid/oversize return preserving exact draft, window teardown; then independent M1 memory/CPU/render measurements.
prohibitedShortcuts: Do not import qa/* Next/proof submit, pending/unknown maps or mock catalogs into production.
Do not replace native input with an always-resident WK editor.
Do not setAttributedString/scope on every render or mirror callback; no polling, CapturePage driver or framework/private retain patch.
Do not use empty/error callback to restore an old a.draft or clear a current invalid fence.
Do not retire unsent semantic drafts under an LRU or claim one NSView proves bounded memory.
Do not label local accepted fixture receipt as real remote send/IME/M1/full-UI acceptance.
